desc:
👹 ONE GIANT. EVERYONE ELSE HAS A GUN. 🔫

Each round, one player becomes a massive Giant with powerful abilities! Everyone else has just 5 minutes to take it down. Fight together, revive teammates, dash out of danger, and use turrets to survive!

🔥 11 UNIQUE GIANTS - Play as the Magma Fiend, Werewolf, Mecha Titan, Gryphon, Anubis, Minotaur, and more!

🔫 17 UNLOCKABLE WEAPONS - Pistols, SMGs, rifles, shotguns, snipers, LMGs, and more!

💥 DESTRUCTIBLE MAPS - Smash through walls, destroy towers, and watch buildings crumble!

🏰 EPIC BATTLEGROUNDS - Battle in haunted villages, carnivals, ancient tombs, frozen harbors, castles, and more!

🎨 CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING - Unlock weapon skins, Giant skins, trails, and finishers!

🏆 LEVEL UP & EARN REWARDS - Complete daily quests, claim rewards, and unlock new gear!

❤️ TEAM UP TO SURVIVE - You have 3 respawns! Revive fallen teammates and work together to defeat the Giant!

🎲 FAIR GIANT SELECTION - The longer you go without becoming the Giant,
